images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: dwelling | On

facade.notes: Lucas County Auditor block card: a 2.5-storey front-gabled Craftsman house with knee brackets, a triple attic window under a striped canvas awning and striped awnings across the full porch; the yard is a raised terrace with its own steps up from the sidewalk; a bungalow next door with a shared side driveway

why.note: lots graded up above the sidewalk (basement spoil, drainage): a terrace with steps marks the front line
canvas awnings on south and west fronts: pre-air-conditioning shading, a 1920s-50s street signature
